posts.text: The New York Times incorrectly reported that “Mr. Trump called into the premier of a C-Span show, APPARENTLY WITHOUT NOTICE.” This is WRONG. The Times knew this, but lied, in order to demean - But this is the least of their lies!

posts.name: Donald Trump
posts.text: A Huge Victory against Fake News BBC, a terrible abuser of the truth, just handed down by highly respected District Court Judge, Jeffrey T. Kuntz, of the Southern District of Florida. posts.text:
Route 66 turns 100 today.

The 2,448-mile road, which was decommissioned in 1985, remains a nostalgic destination for road-trippers with its neon-clad motels and diners, trading posts and vintage cars. https://wapo.st/488K72T

posts.name: The Washington Post
posts.text:
Nearly 97 percent of transgender people who received hormone therapy as teenagers did not regret it five years later, a study found.

Though some patients did regret medically transitioning, those rates are relatively low compared to other medical interventions.
